title: Run the Papyrus pipeline bootstrap once it fits a second organisation
description: Blocked on PPY-1a6aa6. Today `infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh` trusts the Papyrus repository and sets that repository's AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable, so running it for this account would redirect Papyrus's own releases; its stacks also name another organisation's domain. Do not run it until Papyrus changes. This is what brings monitoring into the account.
